title: Exploring the mechanisms of Hu-gu-xiao-ji formula and its components for treatment on non-small cell lung cancer using UPLC-QTOF-MS/MS, network pharmacology, and experiments.
authors: Wang, Jiao; Wang, Xiaoqiang; Li, Yanan; Huang, Qiong; Li, Zunjiang; Zhao, Yunyi; Zhang, Canbin; Ding, Lina; Zhou, Rui; Xiao, Zhenzhen; Yu, Yaya; Zhu, Yanjuan; Zhang, Haibo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方对非小细胞肺癌的作用机制，涉及KEAP1-NRF2蛋白互作，但无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) represents the leading cause of cancer-related morbidity and mortality worldwide, where effective and safe therapeutic options for advanced stages remain limited. The Hu-gu-xiao-ji (HGXJ) formula, derived from traditional formulations including Si-jun-zi decoction and Bu-gu pill, has demonstrated efficacy in alleviating bone pain in metastatic NSCLC. Nevertheless, its active components and underlying mechanisms against primary NSCLC are not fully elucidated. AIM OF THE STUDY: To explore the therapeutic effects, chemical compositions, and molecular mechanisms of HGXJ formula against NSCLC through integrated in vitro and in vivo approaches. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The antitumor efficacy of HGXJ formula was assessed using subcutaneous xenograft models and NSCLC cell lines. Serum-absorbed bioactive compounds were identified by ultra-high performance liquid chromatography-quadrupole tandem time-of-flight mass spectrometry (UPLC-QTOF-MS/MS). Potential targets and signaling pathways were predicted through integrated network pharmacology, bioinformatics analysis, and molecular biology experiments. Molecular docking, cellular assays and in vivo validation were subsequently employed to verify antitumor effects and compound-target interactions. RESULTS: HGXJ formula exhibited significant in vivo and in vitro antitumor activity by promoting apoptosis and inhibiting proliferation. UPLC-QTOF-MS/MS analysis identified 30 blood-entry constituents. Subsequent investigations revealed that HGXJ formula disrupted the kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (KEAP1) -nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (NRF2) antioxidant pathway, triggering reactive oxygen species (ROS) accumulation and consequent cell death. Three bioactive compounds, isobavachin, bavachalcone, and 18beta-glycyrrhetinic acid were screened out and validated to induce ROS-mediated cytotoxicity and target antioxidant pathway. In vivo studies further substantiated the antitumor activity of 18beta-glycyrrhetinic acid and its targeting of KEAP1/NRF2 proteins. CONCLUSION: HGXJ formula and its blood-entry bioactive compounds exerted antitumor effects on NSCLC via suppressing the KEAP1-NRF2 antioxidant axis and inducing ROS-dependent cell death. These findings provide robust evidence supporting the scientific basis for the application of HGXJ formula in advanced NSCLC treatment.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）是全球癌症相关发病率和死亡率的主要原因，而晚期阶段的有效且安全的治疗选择仍然有限。虎骨消积（HGXJ）方，源自包括四君子汤和补骨丸在内的传统方剂，已在转移性NSCLC中显示出缓解骨痛的疗效。然而，其针对原发性NSCLC的活性成分和潜在机制尚未完全阐明。研究目的：通过整合体外和体内方法，探讨HGXJ方对NSCLC的治疗效果、化学成分和分子机制。材料与方法：使用皮下异种移植模型和NSCLC细胞系评估HGXJ方的抗肿瘤功效。通过超高效液相色谱-四极杆串联飞行时间质谱（UPLC-QTOF-MS/MS）鉴定血清吸收的生物活性化合物。通过整合网络药理学、生物信息学分析和分子生物学实验预测潜在靶点和信号通路。随后采用分子对接、细胞实验和体内验证来确认抗肿瘤效应和化合物-靶点相互作用。结果：HGXJ方通过促进凋亡和抑制增殖，在体内和体外均表现出显著的抗肿瘤活性。UPLC-QTOF-MS/MS分析鉴定出30种入血成分。后续研究表明，HGXJ方破坏了kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（KEAP1）-核因子E2相关因子2（NRF2）抗氧化通路，触发活性氧（ROS）积累及随后的细胞死亡。筛选出三种生物活性化合物，异补骨脂黄酮、补骨脂查尔酮和18β-甘草次酸，并验证其诱导ROS介导的细胞毒性和靶向抗氧化通路。体内研究进一步证实了18β-甘草次酸的抗肿瘤活性及其对KEAP1/NRF2蛋白的靶向作用。结论：HGXJ方及其入血生物活性化合物通过抑制KEAP1-NRF2抗氧化轴并诱导ROS依赖性细胞死亡，对NSCLC发挥抗肿瘤作用。这些发现为HGXJ方在晚期NSCLC治疗中的应用提供了强有力的科学依据支持。
